translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: kawutetsaa oydiyaan utteeddawaa ushechcha kushiyan de'iyaawaa be'aaddi; he s'aas'etto mas'aafay laa"u bagganakka s'aafetti utteedda; k'ay laappu maatafay Aa bolla attametteedda.
Taani itti wolk'k'aama kiitanchchay bare k'aalaa d'ok'k'u ootsiide, «Maatafaa dooyyiide, s'aas'etto mas'aafaa billanaw bessiyaa uray oonee?» yaagiide, awaayiyaawaa be'aaddi.
Saluwaan gidina woy sa'aan gidina, woy sa'aappe garssan
gidina, he s'aas'etto mas'aafaa billanaw woy Aa gidduwaa s'eellanaw ooninne bessiyaawe baawa.
S'aatsa mas'aafaa billanaw woy Aa gidduwaa s'eellanaw bessiyaa uray baynna diraw, taani daro yeekkaad.
C'imatuwaappe ittuu taana, «Yeekkoppa; be'a, Yihudaa zariyaa gideedda Gaammuu, Daawite zarii s'ooneedda. I maatafaa dooyyanawunne s'aas'etto mas'aafaa billanaw bessee» yaageedda.

Taani kawutetsaa oydiyaappe, de'uwaan de'iyaa oyddu med'etatuwaappenne k'ay c'imatuwaappe gidduwaan, shuketteedda Dorssaa malatiide ek'k'eeddawaa be'aaddi; aw laappu kac'etuunne laappu ayfetuu de'iino. Hewanttu alamiyaa ubbaa kiitetteedda S'oossaa laappu ayyaanatuwaa.
He Dorssay biide, kawutetsaa oydiyaa bolla utteeddawaa ushechcha kushiyaappe s'aas'etto mas'aafaa akkeedda.

I he s'aas'etto mas'aafaa akkeedda wode, de'uwaan de'iyaa oyddu med'etatuunne laatamanne oyddu c'imatuu Aa sintsan kunddeeddino. Unttunttu huup'iyaan huup'iyaan diitsaanne is'aanay kumeedda work'k'aa miishshaa oyk'k'eeddino. He is'aanay geeshshatuu S'oossaa woossiyaawaa.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, taani s'eellaade, kawutetsaa oydiyaa, de'uwaan de'iyaa oyddu med'etatuwaanne c'imatuwaa yuuyyi aad'd'iide ek'k'eedda daro kiitanchchatuwaa kooshshaa sisaad; unttunttu sha"aaninne miilooniyan paydetteeddino.
He kiitanchchatuu barenttu k'aalaa d'ok'k'u ootsiide,
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, sa'aan, saluwaan, sa'aappe garssaaninne abbaa gidduwaan de'iyaa med'etaa ubbaynne k'ay hewaanttun de'iyaa med'etaa ubbay,
De'uwaan de'iyaa oyddu med'etatuu, «Amen"i» yaagina, c'imatuu guufanniide goyinneeddino.

footnotes.text: S'aas'etto mas'aafaa: Hawaa guussay warak'atan woy galbbaan s'aafetteedda s'aas'ettiyaa mas'aafaa gidiide, daro kare baggana itti woy laa"u bolla bagga galbbaan maatafay attamettee.
